data.translation_en: EXTOL the limitless glory of thy Sustainer's name: [the glory of] the Al-Highest,
who creates [every thing], and thereupon forms it in accordance with what it is meant to be,

data.translation_aya_text: Yang menentukan kadar (masing-masing) dan memberi petunjuk,
data.translation_en: and who determines the nature [of all that exists], and thereupon guides it [towards its fulfilment],
and thereupon causes it to decay into rust-brown stubble!

data.translation_aya_text: Kami akan membacakan (Al-Qur'an) kepadamu (Muhammad) sehingga engkau tidak akan lupa,
data.translation_en: WE SHALL teach thee, and thou wilt not forget [aught of what thou art taught],

data.aya_text: اِلَّا مَا شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ ۗاِنَّهٗ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفٰىۗ
data.translation_aya_text: kecuali jika Allah menghendaki. Sungguh, Dia mengetahui yang terang dan yang tersembunyi.
data.translation_en: save what God may will [thee to forget] - for, verily, He [alone] knows all that is open to [man's] perception as well as all that is hidden [from it]

data.translation_aya_text: Dan Kami akan memudahkan bagimu ke jalan kemudahan (mencapai kebahagiaan dunia dan akhirat),
data.translation_en: and [thus] shall We make easy for thee the path towards [ultimate] ease.

data.translation_aya_text: oleh sebab itu berikanlah peringatan, karena peringatan itu bermanfaat,
data.translation_en: REMIND, THEN, [others of the truth, regardless of] whether this reminding [would seem to] be of use [or not]:

data.translation_aya_text: orang yang takut (kepada Allah) akan mendapat pelajaran,
data.translation_en: in mind will keep it he who stands in awe [of God],

data.translation_aya_text: dan orang-orang yang celaka (kafir) akan menjauhinya,
data.translation_en: but aloof from it will remain that most hapless wretch –

data.translation_aya_text: (yaitu) orang yang akan memasuki api yang besar (neraka),
data.translation_en: he who [in the life to come] shall have to endure the great fire

data.aya_text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوْتُ فِيْهَا وَلَا يَحْيٰىۗ
data.translation_aya_text: selanjutnya dia di sana tidak mati dan tidak (pula) hidup.
data.translation_en: wherein he will neither die nor remain alive.

data.translation_aya_text: Sungguh beruntung orang yang menyucikan diri (dengan beriman),
data.translation_en: To happiness [in the life to come] will indeed attain he who attains to purity [in this world],

data.translation_aya_text: dan mengingat nama Tuhannya, lalu dia salat.
data.translation_en: and remembers his Sustainer's name, and prays [unto Him].

data.translation_aya_text: Sedangkan kamu (orang-orang kafir) memilih kehidupan dunia,
data.translation_en: But nay, [O men,] you prefer the life of this world,

data.translation_aya_text: padahal kehidupan akhirat itu lebih baik dan lebih kekal.
data.translation_en: although the life to come is better and more enduring.

data.translation_aya_text: Sesungguhnya ini terdapat dalam kitab-kitab yang dahulu,
data.translation_en: Verily, [all] this has indeed been [said] in the earlier revelations –
the revelations of Abraham and Moses.
